name: Steve & Kate's Camp at DVFriends
street_address: Delaware Valley Friends School, 19 E Central Avenue
description_short: Day camp run by Steve & Kate's on the Delaware Valley Friends School campus in Paoli for ages 5 to 13, where campers choose their own activities and plan their days. Families buy day passes, with long hours and lunch and snacks included.
notes: 2026: June 15 to August 21, no camp June 19 or July 3, 8 am to 6 pm. Day pass $118 per child per day including lunch and snacks; attend by the day, week or summer with no advance reservation. Students in the DVFriends summer academic program get $30 a day off. The source is the school's summer page, which hosts the camp; steveandkatescamp.com refuses the fetcher and was not read.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. DVFriends Summer Programs page, Option 2: Steve & Kate's Camp at DVFriends, ages 5 to 13, June 15 to August 21, 2026, 8 am to 6 pm, $118 a day with lunch and snacks; campus address in the page footer.
